name: frequency map and deterministic generation
input: frequency beats lexical order and ties are lexical
test:
transition_map = build_frequency_map('a c a b a c')
assert transition_map == {'a': {'c': 2, 'b': 1}, 'c': {'a': 1}, 'b': {'a': 1}}
assert generate_text(transition_map, 'a', 3) == 'a c a c'
assert generate_text(build_frequency_map('a c a b'), 'a', 3) == 'a b'
print('ok')

name: punctuation and casing are normalized
test:
transition_map = build_frequency_map('Hello, WORLD! hello.')
assert transition_map == {'hello': {'world': 1}, 'world': {'hello': 1}}
assert generate_text(transition_map, 'HELLO!', 3) == 'hello world hello world'
print('ok')

name: empty unseen terminal and zero steps
input: empty unseen terminal and zero steps
test:
assert build_frequency_map('123 !!!') == {}
transition_map = build_frequency_map('a b')
assert generate_text({}, 'Start', 10) == 'start'
assert generate_text(transition_map, 'c', 5) == 'c'
assert generate_text(transition_map, 'b', 5) == 'b'
assert generate_text(transition_map, 'a', 0) == 'a'
print('ok')
